definitions.gloss: missed delivery notice; delivery attempt slip
definitions.explanation: A notice left by a delivery person when a package cannot be delivered because no one is home.

examples.japanese: {不在票|ふざいひょう}が{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: There was a missed delivery notice.

examples.japanese: {不在票|ふざいひょう}を{見|み}て{再配達|さいはいたつ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I saw the missed delivery notice and requested redelivery.

examples.japanese: {郵便受|ゆうびんう}けに{不在票|ふざいひょう}が{入|はい}っていたので、{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}に{連絡|れんらく}した。
examples.english: There was a missed delivery notice in the mailbox, so I contacted the delivery office.

notes:
{不在票|ふざいひょう} is the slip left by delivery services when a package cannot be delivered.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}が{入|はい}る (a missed delivery notice is left)
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check the missed delivery notice)

USAGE NOTES:
- Contains information for arranging redelivery
- Usually includes a QR code or phone number

RELATED TERMS:
- {再配達|さいはいたつ}: redelivery
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}: home delivery service
